name: Echoverse Niv-Mizzet
description: In the Echoverse, a spirit dragon and member of the Obzedat who died fighting the nephilim and took a seat on the Ghost Council.

description_citations.text: "Izzet League". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse, Niv-Mizzet dies fighting the nephilim, leaving the Izmagnus to run the guild.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet died in battle against the rampaging nephilim not long after Ravnica's decamillennial , leaving his hand-picked Izmagnus to run the Izzet guild in his absence.

citation.text: "Izzet League", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Echoverse Niv-Mizzet bankrupts the Orzhov Syndicate with life-insurance policies and takes a seat on the Ghost Council.
timeline.quote: he all but bankrupted the Orzhov Syndicate and bought himself a seat on the Ghost Council.

citation.text: "Izzet League", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Echoverse Niv-Mizzet, slain by the nephilim, becomes a spirit dragon and takes sole rule of the Orzhov Syndicate.
timeline.quote: leaving himself as the sole ruler of the Syndicate

citation.text: "Echoverse", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
